title: Closed finite exceptional adjoint and counit on classical inputs
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum of [def-pur-conventions], with $A=A_{E,n}$. Work with ordinary sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaf $A$ on the small etale and pro-etale sites and their ordinary derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $
u_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}	o T_{\mathrm{et}}$ for [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], and $D^+$ for objects with cohomology vanishing sufficiently far below. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, with quasi-compact complementary open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $c=(\operatorname{id}_Z,i)$ be the compactification of $i$, and let $i_c^	imes$ be the ordinary etale right adjoint of $Ri_!^c$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Let $i_{\mathrm{supp}}^	imes$ be the right adjoint of termwise $i_*$ on $D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ in [lem-exc-closed-support-triangle]. There is a canonical natural isomorphism $Ri_!^c\cong Ri_{\mathrm{et},*}\cong i_*$ on the whole unbounded ordinary etale derived category. The resulting unique right-adjoint isomorphism $i_c^	imes\cong i_{\mathrm{supp}}^	imes$ identifies their counits.

For every $B\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, put $D=i_{\mathrm{supp}}^	imes B$ and $K=
u_X^*B$. Then $D$ is bounded below and there is a natural isomorphism
$$Ri^!K=
u_Z^*i_c^	imes R
u_{X,*}
u_X^*B\xrightarrow{\sim}
u_Z^*D.$$
Here $Ri^!$ is exactly the finite transported exceptional functor of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Under $
u_X^*i_*D\cong i_*
u_Z^*D$, its counit on this classical input is the $
u_X^*$-image of the etale closed-support counit $i_*D	o B$. No constructibility assumption is imposed.
